name: bordersize
help:
bordersize [int] sets the border width in pixels.

Example:
    bordersize 5

name: rounding
description: sets window corner rounding in pixels
help:
rounding [int] overrides the default corner rounding.

Example:
    rounding 10

name: roundingpower
help:
roundingpower [float] sets how the rounding curve behaves.

Example:
    roundingpower 1.2

name: allowsinput
help:
allowsinput [0 or 1] lets XWayland windows receive input even if they don't request it.

Example:
    allowsinput 1

name: dimaround
help:
dimaround [0 or 1] dims the screen area outside the window (floating windows only).

Example:
    dimaround 1

name: decorate
description: controls whether window decorations are drawn
help:
decorate [0 or 1] enables decorations (like borders, shadows).

Example:
    decorate 1

name: focusonactivate
help:
focusonactivate [0 or 1] lets Hyprland focus the window when it requests attention.

Example:
    focusonactivate 1

name: keepaspectratio
help:
keepaspectratio [0 or 1] keeps the window's aspect ratio during mouse resizing.

Example:
    keepaspectratio 1

name: nearestneighbor
help:
nearestneighbor [0 or 1] disables smoothing by forcing pixel-perfect rendering.

Example:
    nearestneighbor 1

name: noanim
help:
noanim [0 or 1] disables any animation for the window.

Example:
    noanim 1

name: noblur
description: disables blur effects for the window
help:
noblur [0 or 1] disables blur under or around the window.

Example:
    noblur 1

name: noborder
help:
noborder [0 or 1] hides the window border.

Example:
    noborder 1

name: nodim
help:
nodim [0 or 1] prevents the window from dimming (e.g., during inactivity).

Example:
    nodim 1

name: nofocus
help:
nofocus [0 or 1] makes the window unable to receive focus.

Example:
    nofocus 1

name: nofollowmouse
help:
nofollowmouse [0 or 1] disables mouse-over focus behavior when follow_mouse is enabled.

Example:
    nofollowmouse 1

name: nomaxsize
help:
nomaxsize [0 or 1] removes max size restrictions.

Example:
    nomaxsize 1

name: norounding
help:
norounding [0 or 1] disables corner rounding for the window.

Example:
    norounding 1

name: noshadow
help:
noshadow [0 or 1] prevents drawing shadows around the window.

Example:
    noshadow 1

name: noshortcutsinhibit
help:
noshortcutsinhibit [0 or 1] ensures the app can't block global shortcuts.

Example:
    noshortcutsinhibit 1

name: opaque
help:
opaque [0 or 1] disables transparency entirely.

Example:
    opaque 1

name: forcergbx
description: forces full window opacity by ignoring alpha
help:
forcergbx [0 or 1] makes the window ignore alpha, forcing 100% opacity.

Example:
    forcergbx 1

name: syncfullscreen
description: syncs internal and client fullscreen states
help:
syncfullscreen [0 or 1] ensures fullscreen mode matches the client’s view.

Example:
    syncfullscreen 1

name: immediate
help:
immediate [0 or 1] disables vsync, allowing tearing.

Example:
    immediate 1

name: xray
description: sets blur xray mode for the window
help:
xray [0 or 1] enables xray-style blur behind the window.

Example:
    xray 1

name: renderunfocused
description: forces rendering when window is unfocused
help:
renderunfocused forces the window to keep rendering when it's not visible.

Example:
    renderunfocused

name: scrollmouse
description: sets custom scroll factor for mouse
help:
scrollmouse [float] overrides the input:scroll_factor for this window.

Example:
    scrollmouse 1.5

name: scrolltouchpad
description: sets custom scroll factor for touchpad
help:
scrolltouchpad [float] overrides input:touchpad:scroll_factor.

Example:
    scrolltouchpad 1.2
